environment.version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
environment.authenticationBoundary: Synthetic UUID claims and fixture roles; no Supabase JWT issuance or real accounts.

scope: Actual PostgreSQL SQL, locks, constraints and transactions; two independent native client VMs. REST transport and UUID auth claims are local fixtures, not PostgREST/JWT or real-account validation.

scenarios.name: native grant/reversal/custom reward edits keep the confirmed historical beneficiary and zero is active
explicit V1 adoption preserves a confirmed legacy ISO date without milliseconds through second-client retrieval and reversal
two native clients completing distinct missions rebase per mission without restoring an already completed row
actual concurrent SQL CAS loss is retained and explicit native resolution converges without a duplicate grant
lost response after a real commit replays the original durable operation and applies the current reopened module after reload
offline transport keeps unconfirmed intent and disable does not clear runeSyncRequired before recovery
metadata refusal before RPC sends no business write and preserves the native pending request
metadata refusal after SQL confirmation retains the durable operation for safe replay after reload
native projected recurring occurrence synchronizes once and historical identity cannot silently disappear
server refuses grant for an absent mission atomically while native request and durable rejected operation remain recoverable
